### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/service-automation`, touching **50** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/src/stored-reference-package-backfill.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**46** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620`.

⛔ **17** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-automation/src/stored-reference-package-backfill.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `organization_id (literal, 40 pages)`
- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **11** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1e977dd8bf0d607fa0176fa1ca2583318ff945b4` — the merge of head `0704ffc0478e381ff0eaf59b5c75324bf8eb790c` into base `e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1e977dd8bf0d607fa0176fa1ca2583318ff945b4 && git checkout 1e977dd8bf0d607fa0176fa1ca2583318ff945b4
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620 0704ffc0478e381ff0eaf59b5c75324bf8eb790c && git checkout -B drift-repro e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620 && git merge --no-ff 0704ffc0478e381ff0eaf59b5c75324bf8eb790c

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs e540baf8873c22642ce191b99e7e5ce1fd3b4620` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `e72a24582d75ce784e71810e0ff8933c41f9d074`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Read: 11 files, +866 / -72, all under `packages/services/service-automation/src/` plus one changeset and one sentence in `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx`. No `packages/spec`, `packages/runtime` or `packages/core` file. Check-runs on the head: 53, of which 38 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed.

- **Store rule (`answering`, `connector-connections.ts:225`): right.** A package reads its own rows, plus a package-less row only where the durable resolution names that package or no registry can judge. Two answering rows are refused, never picked. A package-less row of a two-holder name is no package's. This is ADR-0150 D4 and red lines 1 and 2.
- **Door 409 for a two-holder name, and for two declared entries with no registry (`plugin.ts:4501`): right.** The answer it replaces was the first declared entry, which was a guess. Two holders cannot boot while the backstop stands, so no supported caller loses an answer.
- **Callback completes the recorded package; 404 when that package no longer declares the instance: right.** The refusal comes before the code is exchanged. A record with no key resolves the name for its remaining TTL, so an in-flight connect survives the upgrade.
- **Dispatch 503 on a conflict, on both the selection and the refresh read (`grant-handle.ts`): right.** An org-less dispatch counts a conflicted organization and never takes its row.
- **Legacy package-less row, one holder: right.** It is read before the backfill binds it, read after, and stamped in place by a reconnect. Entries with no stamp or the `__runtime__` stamp take the durable holder's package, so the bound row stays theirs. Both are pinned through the booted plugin.
- **Deviations M5, M6 and S3: right.** None loosens resolution. M5 leaves a two-holder name refused at every leg. M6 stamps the entry's own package and the stamped row answers only that package. S3 serves a package its own row, which is not ambiguous.

- **F1 (should-fix): a one-holder answer moves, and the declaration says none does.**
  - (a) Certain. `.changeset/31699-connection-store-package.md:34` states it: an instance whose declaration moved to another package reads "not connected". After #33199 the boot backfill stamps every row, and this PR stamps every new connect. So when the declaring package's id changes (a connector moved between packages, moved to the environment, or a renamed host package), a name that has one holder before and after loses its connection. On `main` the read is by name and the connection keeps dispatching. `connector-connections.ts:225-238` returns only `own` for the new package.
  - The same line says the old row is read by no door "until that package declares the name again or the row is bound". The bind refuses it: `packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts:643-646` answers `already-bound`, "a bound row is never moved". The door's revoke resolves to the new package and leaves the row. So an encrypted refresh token stays stored with no door or CLI path to remove it. On `main` a revoke by name removed it.
  - (b) To answer. `plugin.ts:4519-4524` and the pin at `connector-connection-door.test.ts:1090` serve an entry stamped with package P while the name resolves to package Q. In that composition a legacy package-less row is read by nobody: `answering` gives P only its own rows, and the backfill binds the row to Q. The PR does not say which real composition produces this, and no pin reads a legacy row there.
  - Why it is not a nit: ADR-0150 says adding the coordinate "changes no observable answer for a name phase 1 keeps to one holder"; the card's acceptance (b) allows only its declared narrowing and sends any other to the maintainer; epic ruling 6816940784 R2-C on this card held "a one-holder answer must not move. Declaring the move is not enough."
  - Fix, one of: keep the answer (for example the revoke leg also removes rows naming a package that no longer declares the name while one holder stands, and state what the new holder reads); or take a maintainer ruling that a moved declaration is a new instance under the 01:02Z key decision, declare it on the `Clause-②` line, and give a remedy that works for the stranded row. Either way correct line 34's "or the row is bound", and answer (b) with the composition named or a pin.

- **N1 (nit): `.changeset/31699-connection-store-package.md:40` (S3) gives a remedy that cannot run in the state it describes.** It says to revoke the package's own row first, but line 38 (M5) says revoke is refused 409 under two holders. The working path is to uninstall one holder; the one-holder read then refuses two rows and the revoke clears both.
- **N2 (nit): `connector-connections.ts:642` is unreachable in effect.** `answering` throws the conflict only when the package has no row of its own, so the filter on the next line is always empty and line 643 always rethrows.
- **N3 (nit): `plugin.ts:4173` fixes the grant handle's package when the handle is created, while the door asks per request.** The PR body carries the per-read evaluation to 3b. With one holder and a real stamp the two agree.

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/service-automation': patch`, with `Metadata-protocol: none`: right. No authorable key, value or type moves, and AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3 ships a non-protocol change as `patch`. `Check Changeset` is green. The ADR-0087 marker (`not-required`) fits: no authorable schema changes.
- The declaration line, as written in the PR body and at changeset line 7, is `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. `yes` is right. The arm and its sentence are **wrong as written** (F1): the diff publishes no wider accept set on any public surface (the changeset itself says "In-process APIs. None public"), every item under "What answers differently" is a tighter answer, and one of them is reachable with one holder, one row and the guard standing. The sentence "on a database where each organization keeps one connection of an instance and the name has one holder, every answer is as before" is contradicted by line 34.
- If the moved-declaration answer stays as built, the line that matches the diff carries the `(narrowing)` arm. That arm is BREAKING and its review is owed at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which this record does not serve.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **No `os-dev-report` for this PR is on the card.** The latest report (6869754560) is for #33199. The flags read here are the PR body's and handover 6871869590's.
- M5, M6, S3: answered in ①, accepted.
- "Carried to 3b: re-key the grant handles by `(package, name)` and evaluate the handle's package per read": answered as N3; correct to carry while one holder stands.
- File surface against claim amendment 6869821095: `stored-reference-package-backfill.ts` is outside it. The change there is three comment lines (`:48-50`) that keep the R11 note true. Accepted as a deviation; the ACCEPT should name it.
- `open_questions`: none stated for this PR. F1 (b) is this record's question to the dev.
- Author: the PR's `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no further note is owed.
- Escalated: F1's ruling option belongs to the maintainer, per the card's acceptance line on a narrowing beyond the declared one.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `0704ffc0478e381ff0eaf59b5c75324bf8eb790c`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Delta: 5 files, +148 / -67. `connector-connections.ts` (the rule), a three-line comment in `plugin.ts`, the changeset, and the two test files. No new file, no path outside the earlier surface.

**The new rule (`connector-connections.ts:231-254`): right.** While the name's durable resolution does not refuse (one holder, the environment's item, no holder, or no registry), every row of the name in the organization answers the instance, whatever package the row names. That is `main`'s read by name, so no one-holder answer moves. Only under a refused resolution (two holders) does each package read its own rows; a row naming no package or a non-holder is then no package's and is refused 409 when it is all the package has. Resolution does not loosen against `main`: with one holder there is one candidate, and with two nothing is picked.

- **F1 (a): resolved.**
  - A declaration moved to another package or to the environment keeps its connection: `connector-connections.ts:240` returns every row.
  - The stranded token is gone: `revoke` (`:650`) deletes every answering row, so the moved row is removed through the door.
  - A reconnect restamps the row in place, `null` included (`:488`), so it stays one row.
  - Pins: `connector-connection-package.test.ts:148` (to another package, to the environment, and the two-holder counterpart) and `connector-connection-door.test.ts:1090` (read, dispatch and revoke through the booted plugin after the holder changes).
  - The changeset line that claimed "or the row is bound" is deleted.
- **F1 (b): resolved.** An entry stamped P while the name resolves to Q is one holder, so a legacy package-less row answers P's instance. Pinned at `connector-connection-door.test.ts:1114` (the commit that makes this head) and at store level at `connector-connection-package.test.ts:141`. The real composition is still not named, and no longer needs to be: the answer there is `main`'s.
- **N1: resolved.** The S3 remedy (changeset line 39) now says the door is refused at every leg under two holders and the row is removed by uninstalling one holder, then revoking.
- **N2: resolved.** The dead fallback in `revoke` is removed; `:650` calls `answering` once and lets the conflict through.
- **N3: moot while one holder stands.** A grant handle whose package went stale still reads the row, because every row answers. The per-read evaluation stays carried to 3b, where it matters.

New in the delta, all nits:

- **N4 (nit): the 409 message and changeset line 32 offer `bind` for a row "naming a package that is not one of the holders".** `bind` refuses any row that already names a package (`packages/cli/src/utils/stored-package-references.ts:643`, `already-bound`). The second remedy in the same sentence (uninstall one holder, then revoke) works, so no row is stuck. Message at `connector-connections.ts:249-252`.
- **N5 (nit): the PR body is stale against this head.** Its "What changes / Store" bullet and the 维护者速读 still describe the old rule ("plus a package-less row only where the name's durable resolution binds it to that package"), its S3 line still says "until bound and revoked", and Verification does not list the F1 pins. The seat writes the body; the declaration lines in it are correct.
- **N6 (nit, carry to the narrowing PR): a row's stamp is refreshed only by a reconnect.** After a move from A to B the row may still name A while B uses it. Once two holders can boot, if A declares the name again, that row reads as A's and B reads "not connected". Nothing reaches this while the backstop stands. The narrowing PR should restamp or report such rows before it lifts the backstop.
- **N7 (nit): changeset line 7 says "every answer is as before" for a one-holder database, and the list below it keeps one exception.** A connect in flight (at most ten minutes) whose recorded package stops declaring the instance is refused 404 at the callback before its code is used. The refusal is right and is listed at line 33; the sentence should except it.

### ② Semver level

- `'@objectstack/service-automation': patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`: right, unchanged. No authorable key, value or type moves. The ADR-0087 marker (`not-required`) still fits.
- The declaration line `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, in the PR body and at changeset line 7, now **holds**. The reason the first record refused it is gone: no answer on a supported database tightens. What remains under "What answers differently" needs two holders (which cannot boot), two rows answering one instance (a refused guard), or the in-flight callback of N7. None is a narrowing that owes the `(narrowing)` arm.
- Check-runs on `0704ffc0` at the time of reading: 22 registered, 0 failed.
  - Concluded, 3, all skipped: `Schedule gate · skip when a green push run covers the commit`, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `18.x upgrade harness (opt-in)`.
  - In progress, 19: `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Documentation Links`, `Flag docs affected by code changes`, `Spec property liveness`, the eight `Lint ·` jobs and the four `Type Check ·` jobs.
  - Not yet registered: the CI workflow's jobs, `Build Core` and the `Test Core` shards among them, which run the new pins.
- This verdict is the contract reading of the diff. It certifies no gate on this head: `Check Changeset` and `Test Core` have not concluded. The seat's landing check (every PR check green) is still owed, and a red there reopens this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- F1 was escalated in the first record with two options. The dev took "keep the answer", so no maintainer ruling is owed.
- The fix quotes ADR-0150 red line 3 and epic ruling R2-C as its ground (`connector-connections.ts:213-220`); both are on the card and say what the code now does.
- M5, M6, S3: still accepted. M6's sentence was corrected to "while two packages hold the name, the stamped row answers only its own package", which matches the new rule.
- No `os-dev-report` for this PR or this round is on the card as read in round 1; the flags read are the PR body's, the changeset's and the commit messages'.
- File surface: unchanged from round 1. `stored-reference-package-backfill.ts` (comment only) is still the one path outside claim amendment 6869821095, for the ACCEPT to name. Its comment at `:48-50` now understates the rule (it describes only the row left null), which belongs with N5's prose.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no further note is owed.
- N4 to N7 are nits: accepted deviations, prose-face edits or a carry. They do not need another round from this reviewer.

## 维护者速读 · PR #33218 @ `0704ffc0` · 2026-11-14T15:00Z

- 改了什么：连接存储、连接门（读 / 开始 / 回调 / 撤销）、OAuth 回调和派发都带上实例的包。开始连接时把包记进待完成授权，回调只完成那个包的实例（该包不再声明时 404，且在用掉授权码之前拒绝）。存储规则（`answering`）：名字只有一个持有者、或没有注册表可判时，该组织里这个名字的每一行都回答这个实例，与按名字读完全一样；连接时就地认领并改戳，撤销时删掉。只有两个持有者时，每个包才只读自己的行。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D4，#31699 PR 3a 的第二半（第一半 #33199 已加宽唯一键）。
- 权限与边界：一持有者兜底仍在，所以支持的库上没有答复变紧。声明移到另一个包或移到环境，连接照旧可用（复审 F1 后改成这样）。新的拒绝只在两持有者（启动时进不来）或一个实例有两行（被守卫拒绝）时出现。
- 风险与回滚：正文里的「Store」条、维护者速读和 S3 一句描述的是复审前的旧规则，以本评论和 changeset 为准（见下）。回滚即 revert，没有迁移，不改存储结构。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-automation/src/connector-connections.ts` 第 213-254 行（`answering`），以及 `src/plugin.ts` 的 `connectorInstancePackage`、`connectionDoorInstance`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：落地。`Clause-② yes (widening)`，复审先 FAIL（F1：一持有者的答复会因声明换包而移动），修复后 delta PASS；CI 无失败，非受管面，1019 行。

## 席位核对

- **形态:** draft → `main`。正文写 `Part of #31699`，合并后卡保持打开（3b 和收窄 PR 还在后面）；正文其他地方没有挨着别的 open 卡号的闭合关键词。
  - 申报 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`、`Metadata-protocol: none`，changeset `'@objectstack/service-automation': patch`。
  - 文件面 = 接管认领 6857670747，加修订 6869821095（3a-ii）；本席恢复认领 6878990173。
- **前提实测:** dev 报告 6878937714（0704ffc0 之前的 6a982f72 上）：`connector-connection-package.test.ts` 13 条、`connector-connection-door.test.ts` 50 条，经真 ObjectQL / SQLite 与启动的插件。消融：一持有者规则退回「自己的行加未绑定行」红 4 条；退回复审前规则红 F1(b) 钉；去掉 `null` 改戳红 1 条；另有红线轮的 11 条。`@objectstack/service-automation` 全量 281 文件、3875 条通过。
- **门禁 check-runs @ `0704ffc0`:** 38 success、15 skipped、0 失败、0 进行中（Build Core、Test Core 8 片与 Type Check 四项都已通过，跑过新的 F1 钉）。
